basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco's Richmond District, this well-maintained two-unit building with a legal ground-level studio offers a strong income-producing opportunity. Each of the upper flats features three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, formal living and dining rooms, and access to a large private deck.  A perfect place to unwind and take in the expansive views of the ocean and Golden Gate Park.  All three units including the ground-level studio are tenant-occupied and generate immediate rental income. The interiors have been tastefully updated with modern finishes throughout.  The property includes a generous three-car garage and a large, newly fenced backyard, perfect for tenant enjoyment, added privacy, and long-term value. Conveniently located near the shops and restaurants along Balboa Street, Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Lands End Trail, the Legion of Honor, and public transit on Geary Boulevard.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a fully leased property with scenic views in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
